title: fix(ci): judge a cancelled single-leg roster by its recorded cancel cause (Dogfood Regression Gate)
body:
Fixes #22606
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Ruling executed: the seat's answer to the `needs_decision` report (issue comment `6095991649`, the patch round on claim `6095790862`). It decides by the cancel cause GitHub records, on the single-leg path only. #16157's partial-attestation behaviour is untouched; #22653 is not addressed here.

## What changed

The required `Dogfood Regression Gate` passed `Dogfood Verify CLI` (`dogfood-verify`, a 1/1 roster) after its own `timeout-minutes` killed it mid-suite. Run `38021470264` is the measured case. With zero attestations of its own, a cancelled leg reads as #3668's superseded shape. A sibling leg does not settle it either. Run `37984828810` gives `judge()` the same inputs (dogfood 3/3 attested, `dogfood-verify` cancelled with zero), and that run was a genuine supersession. So on that path the gate now reads the cause the platform recorded.

**`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`**

- `legsNeedingCancelCause(legs, present)` is pure and shared by `judge()` and `--verify`. It names a leg only when all of these hold:
  - its roster is a single leg (`total` 1);
  - it reads `cancelled` with none of its own credentials present;
  - another leg of the same gate has a credential present.

  It never names a matrix leg.
- `--verify` makes API requests only for those legs. Every other run makes no request and needs no token. It sends exactly two documented GETs:
  - `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs` lists THIS attempt's jobs, because `needs.LEG.result` is this attempt's. The leg's job is found by its display name.
  - `GET {check_run_url}/annotations` reads that job's annotations. The result is handed to `judge()` as a per-leg cause, and `judge()` stays pure.
- The verdict on that path:
  - `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time…` means the roster is REQUIRED. The credential is listed `MISSING`, and the gate goes red naming `dogfood-verify` and quoting the cause.
  - `Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for…` means superseded, and #3668's pass applies. The log quotes the cause.
  - Any other cause, a manual cancel included, is red: the gate fails closed and says why. So is an unreadable cause: no token, an unreadable run id or attempt, a refused or malformed jobs list, the leg absent or listed twice, the leg not `cancelled` in the list, or refused annotations.
- `--verify` reads the display name from the workflow TEXT (`workflowJobDisplayName`). The gate job checks out and runs `node` without installing dependencies, so `yaml` is not available there.
- The static guard (`node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`, run in lint) now requires three things of any gate that counts a single-leg roster beside another leg:
  - a `permissions` block that grants `actions: read` and `checks: read`;
  - `GITHUB_TOKEN` in the `--verify` step's env;
  - a leg `name:` that the text reading resolves to exactly the parsed YAML name.

  While I was writing the guard, it caught a real shadowing bug in its own text reading.
- Matrix legs are unchanged, and both readings are pinned as controls:
  - #16157's count (a partially attested cancelled matrix is red);
  - the every-leg-cancelled pass.

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `dogfood-gate` only**

- `permissions` gains `actions: read` and `checks: read`, beside `contents: read`.
- The `Verify dogfood shard results` step's env gains `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` (the `lint.yml` spelling).
- No job or step is renamed.
- `test-gate` is untouched. It aggregates exactly one leg (`--leg "test/6:…"`), so it has no single-leg roster.

## Premise, verified before the code

- **(a) and (b): documented permissions.** Source: GitHub's own permission ledger, `github/docs` `src/github-apps/data/fpt-2022-11-28/server-to-server-permissions.json` at `be38ec5`.
  - `list-jobs-for-a-workflow-run-attempt`, `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt_number}/jobs`: permission `actions`, access `read`, `server-to-server: true`, `additional-permissions: false`.
  - `list-check-run-annotations`, `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/{check_run_id}/annotations`: permission `checks`, access `read`, `server-to-server: true`, `additional-permissions: false`.
  - `data/reusables/actions/github-token-scope-descriptions.md`: "If you specify the access for any of these permissions, all of those that are not specified are set to `none`." The job declared only `contents: read`, so both scopes were `none` until now.
  - `workflow-syntax.md`, "How permissions are calculated for a workflow job": a forked `pull_request` only turns write scopes into read. No rule singles out `push` or `merge_group`, so read scopes hold on all three events.
- **(c): a `git push` of the `ci.yml` edit was accepted from this container.** It went up as its own first commit, `ab46de92b`, before any script change.
- ⚠️ **NOT MEASURED:** a real Actions job's `GITHUB_TOKEN` performing the two reads. This PR's own CI reaches the path only if a `dogfood-verify` cancellation lands beside an attested sibling. The live replays below ran with this container's proxy credentials, not a job token.

## Live replay of the two measured runs (real API, through `--verify`)

The credentials were emitted for each run id, and the leg results are the runs' own.

Run `38021470264`, killed. Exit 1:

```
  leg dogfood-verify (single leg) — aggregate result: cancelled
    cancelled by its OWN job timeout ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 20m0s — check run 114123251343") while a sibling leg attested — not a superseded run; the roster is REQUIRED (#22606)
    - dogfood-verify-1-of-1  MISSING
    attested 0 / 1 declared shard(s)
::error::Dogfood Regression Gate: leg dogfood-verify (single leg) published no positive attestation (dogfood-verify-1-of-1) — it was killed by its own job timeout ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 20m0s — check run 114123251343") while a sibling leg of this gate attested, so it produced no verdict at all. A killed leg is not a passing leg, see #22606.
```

Run `37984828810`, superseded. Exit 0:

```
  leg dogfood-verify (single leg) — aggregate result: cancelled
    satisfied (cancelled — superseded, per the leg's own check run: "Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-push-refs/heads/main exists — check run 114005072147" — #3668; expected attestations: 0)
Dogfood Regression Gate: satisfied — all 3 declared shard(s) published a positive attestation.
```

## Ablation

The fix was committed first, at `80e3b2313`. The mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with an EXIT/INT/TERM restore and a second `git checkout HEAD --` trap.

- **Mutation:** `const needsCause = new Set(legsNeedingCancelCause(legs, present));` becomes `const needsCause = new Set();`. This drops the cause read back to the per-leg count.
- **Proof it landed:** the tool reports anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, and blob `22c4dd3c` to `e8c24366`. An on-disk grep inside the run counts the marker 1 and the original 0.
- **Self-test:** exit 1 with 12 failures. Among them:
  - `run 38021470264: dogfood-verify killed by its own timeout beside 3/3 attested ⇒ red`;
  - the leg-naming and `MISSING` pins;
  - the unreadable, refused and manual-cancel cases;
  - `end to end: read, then judged — the killed leg is red`.

  The superseded and control cases stay green, as intended.
- **`--verify` replay of run 38021470264:** exit 0 with `satisfied (cancelled — run-lifecycle state, #3668; expected attestations: 0)`. This is the card's false green, back.
- **Restore:** blob after restore equals HEAD (`22c4dd3c`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Self-test

`node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test` exits 0 with 218 assertions, up from 144. Three batteries were added, with floors pinned at their measured counts:

| battery | floor |
|:--|:--|
| `#22606 single-leg cancel cause: the platform's recorded cause decides` | 29 |
| `#22606 the cause read, offline: two documented GETs, and every failure is unreadable` | 32 |
| `#22606 the static guard pins the cause read where the verdict needs it` | 13 |

`SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` goes from 16 to 19. The API is driven offline through an injected `fetchJson`. The live fetcher retries once on a 5xx, a 429 or a network failure, never on a 4xx, and its failures never carry the token.

## Gates, all at `80e3b2313`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derives 57 commands. Each exit code was captured by redirect, never through a pipe.

- **52 exit 0.** These include:
  - `pnpm check:shard-attestation`;
  - `pnpm check:required-contexts`;
  - `node scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`, plus its `--self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:workflow-status-functions`;
  - `pnpm check:workflow-step-name-quoting`;
  - `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs`, plus its `--self-test`;
  - `pnpm check:nul-bytes`;
  - `pnpm check:stall-guard-budget`.
- **`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`** (run detached, exit captured to a file): exit 0, `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1825 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred.`
- **Reconciliation:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` exits 0 with `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 57 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 53 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- **Exit 3, NOT MEASURED (declared narrowing):** `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`.
  - Each refused for want of built `dist/`.
  - They are derived because `Build Core` in `ci.yml` runs them.
  - This diff touches no package source and no build step; its `ci.yml` edit is two lines of `dogfood-gate`. So their verdicts cannot move, and `Build Core` runs them on this PR.
- **Other checks:**
  - `node scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs --self-test` (it imports this module) exits 0.
  - `eslint --no-inline-config scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` exits 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff moves no other file's verdict.
  - A control-byte scan of both files is clean.
- **Not applicable:** no `*.test.ts` names `check-shard-attestation`.

Since then, `origin/main` has moved to `d817f1869`. The 2 new commits touch neither file, and the PR's CI runs on the merge ref.

## Changeset

None. Root `scripts/` and a workflow publish nothing from any package, so this PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **How often the path fires.** Read off the Actions API for the 51 h window 2026-10-08T05:51Z to 2026-10-10T08:50Z, the cause read would have been asked 10 times: `dogfood-verify` was cancelled with zero attestations beside an attested `dogfood` in 10 runs.
  - 1 was a recorded timeout (`38021470264`). It is now red.
  - 5 were supersessions with dogfood 3/3 attested, e.g. `37984828810`. They stay green.
  - 4 were supersessions with dogfood partially attested. They stay red under #16157, unchanged.
- **Fail-closed by ruling.** A transient API failure on this path paints red. The fetcher retries once.
- **NOT MEASURED: a gate-only re-run.** On an attempt where `dogfood-verify` itself was not re-run, whether that attempt's jobs list carries the leg is unmeasured. If it does not, the cause reads unreadable and the gate fails closed (red).
- **Narrowing.** A green becomes a red, hence `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` per the seat's answer. This needs a contract-review-tier review before the queue.
